rationale: A has the clearer state model: paragraphs are buffered, list items are emitted as complete elements, and list/paragraph flushing is localized in small closures. It also preserves the original document-wide emphasis behavior, handles empty input more gracefully, and avoids B's awkward pointer-based closing helpers and temporarily unclosed list items. B is readable, but its per-line emphasis subtly changes behavior across line boundaries and its paragraph handling renders empty input as an empty paragraph.
